paraphrase: The general view: the base of all (kun gzhi) is empty and clear; awareness (rig pa) is inseparable from it; their inseparability is the natural state, uncreated and without deviation.
notes: Reference from the unit author's knowledge (not read in a local text in this phase). Optional (Bön). Section-level reference from general knowledge.

paraphrase: Seeing awareness nakedly: the master introduces the disciple to naked awareness beyond the conceptual mind, likened to the sky, the sun and its rays; one then rests in it without correction.
notes: Reference from the unit author's knowledge (not read in a local text in this phase). Optional (Bön). Section-level reference from general knowledge.

paraphrase: Tapihritsa, appearing as a boy, questions the learned Gyerpung Nangzher Löpo and shows him that his pride in scholarship and powers obstructs the natural state, then transmits the teaching that became the Oral Transmission.
notes: Reference from the unit author's knowledge (not read in a local text in this phase). Optional (Bön). Section-level reference from general knowledge.
